verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitHub ships CI/CD through GitHub Actions, but describes it as running 'right in your repository' (repo-scoped). The only route to cross-org visibility is building it yourself on the general-purpose REST/GraphQL APIs, which are documented for retrieving data but not specifically for workflow runs. Missing for 10: an evidenced organization-level dashboard or view of workflow runs, documented org-wide run-history or monitoring endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of centralized CI/CD visibility.
